channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US CENTCOM tells Al Jazeera Hormuz blockade ‘highly effective’
item.description: The spokesman for US Central Command has told Al Jazeera its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is ‘highly effective’.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says US nearing end of war, claims Tehran direct talks
item.description: President Trump says the US is nearing the end of the conflict with Iran and claims direct talks with Tehran.

item.title: US military claims Strait of Hormuz remains open amid ongoing blockade
item.description: The comments from a US CENTCOM spokesperson come amid continued tensions over shipping through the vital waterway.

item.title: New video claims to show Saudi fighter jet Houthis say they shot down
item.description: Houthi forces have released a video claiming to show a Saudi fighter jet the group says was shot down in Yemen’s Marib.

item.title: Efforts underway for Zelenskyy-Trump meeting at UN next week
item.description: Trump pushes for a solution to end Moscow's war against Kyiv as civilian deaths in Ukraine rise.

item.title: Republican US senator slams Trump vaccine policy amid rising measles deaths
item.description: US Senator Bill Cassidy presses Trump's pick for surgeon general on views over vaccines, public health.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: US to send $2.8BN worth of weapons to Israel
item.description: A 15-year-old boy was killed in a double-tap strike while trying to save a paramedic.

item.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
item.description: A wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings are among the images obtained by the BBC's partner CBS News.

item.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
item.description: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
item.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".
